china-1924-5:p0834_2.rationale: Maritime Customs collections by port for 1923 with year-on-year variation; this is customs revenue.

china-1924-5:p0838_1.rationale: Cash statement of receipts and payments of the National Consolidated Loan Service: coupons cashed, bonds redeemed, sinking fund and balances.

china-1924-5:p0838_2.rationale: Lists liabilities for unpaid interest coupons and drawn but unredeemed bonds covered by the year-end loan service cash balance.

china-1924-5:p0839_1.rationale: Schedule of 1923 loan redemptions and interest by date, loan and drawing, with total obligation.

china-1924-5:p0839_2.rationale: Computes total loan service liability for 1923, receipts and arrears on government loans.

china-1924-5:p0840_1.rationale: Lists loan drawings due for redemption that make up the obligation in arrears.

china-1924-5:p0841_1.rationale: Statement of national and consolidated loans: issued, drawn and outstanding principal, interest rates, dates and 1924 payments.

china-1924-5:p0841_2.rationale: Lists consolidated loan drawings in arrears on 1 January 1924 with due dates and amounts.

china-1924-5:p0842_1.rationale: Allotment of the Boxer indemnity among the Powers by percentage, taels and foreign currency under the 1901 Protocol.

china-1924-5:p0848_1.rationale: Salt Administration revenue account listing loan and indemnity charges secured on salt revenue for 1921-1923. The debt-service component is the main focus.
review_questions: Would a tag for salt revenue securing loans (salt-revenue-securities) be useful? The existing salt-tax tag may not fit because the table shows loan charges rather than tax receipts.
